title: Mammoths Were Still Alive When the Pyramids Were Built

scenes.text: Woolly mammoths were still alive when the pyramids were already five hundred years old.
The Great Pyramid of Giza went up around twenty-five fifty BC. The last mammoths died out around two thousand BC.
They lived on Wrangel Island, a frozen rock off the coast of Siberia, cut off from the mainland by rising seas.
A twenty twenty-four study in the journal Cell found the whole island herd started from fewer than ten animals.
They survived there for about six thousand years, isolated, while humans invented writing and built cities.
Nobody knows exactly what finally killed them. Which ancient animal do you wish were still around?

description:
Woolly mammoths were still alive when the Great Pyramid was already 500 years old.
The pyramid went up around 2550 BC. The last mammoths lived on Wrangel Island, off Siberia, until about 2000 BC. A 2024 study in the journal Cell found the island population started from fewer than ten animals and survived for about 6,000 years.
Nobody knows exactly what finally wiped them out.
Which ancient animal do you wish were still around?
